record.rationale: Browser binding for uprv_getDefaultLocaleID captures Intl resolvedOptions().locale once, supplying a semantic language-tag identity to the original ICU normalization/default cache. No POSIX LC_MESSAGES/environment/charset model, independent OS equivalent or invented fallback is claimed. Actual getRoot/default host-query count is covered by source-backed unit tests and the shared semantic-input native fixture; host API failure and native platform equivalence remain uncertified.
